scope: THE STRUCTURAL OMISSION: the protocol requires a full BASELINE snapshot with all 14 sections present, ACKed by the client, before deltas are accepted - and our server has never sent one

what_cols_documents.cols:164: /// A full baseline with command time and health, no entities/clients/weapons.

what_cols_documents.cols:166: pub fn bootstrap(server_time) -> full baseline snapshot
what_cols_documents.cols:177: /// After a baseline ACK, delta-distance zero with flags0 selects the cached
what_cols_documents.cols:178: /// full baseline for section histories; playerState still selects no base.
what_cols_documents.cols:182: establish_baseline: bool - the frame function has an explicit baseline-establishing mode

the_protocol_it_implies: step 1: the server sends a full baseline snapshot in which ALL 14 sections are present in full, not delta-compressed
step 2: the client acknowledges that baseline
step 3: only afterwards do delta snapshots (distance 0 with flags 0) resolve against the cached baseline
and the playerState section still selects no base even after the ACK, which matches the playerState behaviour measured in earlier rounds
what_our_server_does_instead: grep over server1649370/*.py for 'baseline' returns NOTHING
the server sends a gamestate and then only delta-style snapshots
so the client never receives a baseline to cache, and every delta it gets references a base that does not exist
which is exactly why the loader object at [0x8269774] never clears and why the frame stays black with a spinner
why_this_explains_the_whole_investigatio: the project spent dozens of rounds perfecting the CONTENT of delta snapshots (playerState fields, entity counts, entity deltas, positions) while the prerequisite message was never sent
that is why every advance in snapshot content changed numbers but never the picture
and it is the same class of error as the state-10 oracle: the work was correct in form but aimed at a layer above the missing one
the_concrete_next_step: build a full baseline snapshot: all 14 sections present in full form, with no entities and no clients

the client's own parser already has the section-presence flags (the 0x471xxx block dispatch and the per-section entry points are known), so the baseline can be constructed by setting every section flag to 'present in full' and emitting each section's full form
and the snapshot sequence must start with that baseline before any delta
